findings.evidence: TauCeti/Geometry/Symplectic/Lagrangian/Basic.lean:436–437 proves the same result with identical assumptions; membership in both subspaces is precisely x.2 = 0.
findings.fix: Delete the new theorem and use SymplecticForm.isLagrangian_prod_top_bot, rewriting ⊤.prod ⊥ as ker snd by submodule extensionality.
findings.issue: isLagrangian_stdSymplecticForm_ker_snd duplicates SymplecticForm.isLagrangian_prod_top_bot under equality of the subspaces.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Module/Equiv/Basic.lean:684–694 provides skewProd and its inverse formulas; Equiv/Prod.lean:67 provides prodComm. Swapping coordinates before and after (p,q) ↦ (p,q+p) gives the required map.
findings.fix: Define symplecticShear using ContinuousLinearEquiv.skewProd with identity diagonal blocks and identity off-diagonal map, conjugated by ContinuousLinearEquiv.prodComm.
findings.issue: The explicit forward/inverse assembly reimplements the existing continuous linear shear combinator.

findings.evidence: TauCeti/Geometry/Symplectic/Lagrangian/Basic.lean:266 supplies Tames.isSymplectic_of_mem_invtSubmodule; StandardCompatible.lean:96 supplies stdSymplecticForm_tames_product. The current hJx already establishes the required invariance.
findings.fix: Apply stdSymplecticForm_tames_product.isSymplectic_of_mem_invtSubmodule and prove invariance using Module.End.mem_invtSubmodule and weightRotation_product_apply.
findings.issue: The orthogonality and inner-product argument rederives the existing theorem that a subspace stable under a tamed complex structure is symplectic.

summary: The Lagrangian fixed-subspace theorem duplicates an existing declaration. The shear construction and rotation nondegeneracy proof also bypass existing reusable API.
